localChecks: Wrong key, tampering and malformed archives rejected
Unconfigured Preview exposes no recovery endpoint and opens no database
Bearer, canonical host and browser-origin boundary checks
Interruption after MySQL commit resumes only the same archive
Lost success response does not reapply completed restore
Fresh sign-in still requires MFA; reused MFA code rejected
limitations: Live rehearsal used the private SQLite catalog backend and the exact v0.4.1 package on both apps. Other schemas and the full MySQL catalog are not qualified by this test.
The post-rehearsal queued-mail suppression safeguard is covered by the local integration test; the live fixture had no pending mail to suppress.
Backup files, keys, credentials, app identities and operation records remain private.
